Such names, like "Prabhakar" (one who illumines the world) or "Bhallal" (brave as a tiger), are rooted in Hindu traditions that celebrate the qualities of knowledge, wisdom, courage, and internal light. The name "Bl" can be a reminder of these values and inspire those who bear it to radiate light and brilliance in their actions, thoughts, and speech.
